notes.title: 🛠 Dev Update — 3 Months of Progress!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
It’s been a while — three months of silence, to be exact — but don’t worry, we’ve been working non-stop behind the scenes. The game is still in active development, and we’re proud to say: these past three months were absolutely worth it.

We know we previously mentioned a release window, but we’ll need more time. Why?
Because we’re not a big studio — we’re a small, passionate team pouring everything we have into this world. Every day, we’re pushing it forward.

Here’s what’s been going on behind the curtain:


🎣 Fishing System
We’ve added 120+ unique fish types, along with various items you can pull out of the water.
We’re actively balancing drop rates and crafting quest lines tailored specifically to this skill.
[hr][/hr]🧠 Skill System Overhaul
Introducing 25 new skills to enhance your character’s abilities.
You’ll receive 30 skill points total — with each skill upgradeable to level 10.
Choose your build wisely — every decision matters.
[hr][/hr]🏡 Building System Revamp
The house-building mechanic has been completely reimagined!
We added a pseudo-block system for more creative freedom.
Customize your space, build additional defense layers — and soon, we’re adding fences and defense mechanisms too!
[hr][/hr]🎨 Visual Upgrades: UI, Pets, Main Menu
We’re diving deeper into a refined, stylized art direction.
New interfaces, companions, and a redesigned main menu are all in progress.
It takes time — but trust us, it’s worth every pixel.
[hr][/hr]❌ Why No Steam Update Yet?
We know you’re eager — and we are too.
But we won’t release unfinished content.
The current version is a super early alpha for stress-testing server bugs — not final gameplay.
Instead of dropping tiny updates, we’re building something that will completely redefine your experience.


💬 From the Heart
To everyone patiently waiting — thank you.
We’re working hard, learning, growing, and dreaming big.
This is our first game, and we’re determined to make it legendary.

Together with Piworld… Onward to Adventure!

— The Dev Team 💚

notes.title: 4th April news about future content!
notes.content:
How long have we been silent. But our silence holds the mysteries of something new, something unexplored, something mysterious...
Yes, friends, we are still actively working on our beloved and wonderful game! Referring to our plans, I am preparing to give answers to what was planned and what was done:

And here is the list

January/early February - armor system, food, as well as ore, anvil, and additional crafts - IS! Fully functional, completely ready. In the future, we will simply supplement the number
February/March - farming, fishing system, and translations - IS! Added translations into a large number of languages, and also added descriptions to almost all items!
March/April - experience and character leveling system - In progress! The character level can already be pumped by fishing, but we are adding other sources. Remember, remember! Work, work!
April/May - the system of economy, trade, and interaction with NPCs - we haven't gotten around to it yet, but we are on our way!
May - release of the version for mobile phones - testing optimization on mobile devices, and introducing updates


The game does not receive updates on Steam for one simple reason - I DO NOT want to give players raw and untested content. The version that is available now is a super early alpha beta gamma access, to search for extensive bugs related to the server. We want to release a version that can be played for a very long time and with pleasure. Why should we feed you small updates now if we can release something that will completely change the idea of ​​our game?

Thanks to everyone who is waiting for news and updates. We are trying very hard, researching, developing. This is our first game, and we want to make it legendary. Together with Piworld! Onward to adventure!

notes.title: Roadmap for the next 6 months!
notes.content:
Hello survivor! I hope you've already managed to get a feel for the world of Piworld in the form it currently exists. Yes, this is a VERY raw game, very little content, but the most important thing is that you support our game. Personally, in my head this game is associated with something great, some kind of project that you can really get stuck into for more than 100 hours, after we release all the ideas and concepts. That's why I want to write about future updates now, so that everyone understands where we're heading:


January/early February - adding the armor system, food, as well as ore, anvil, and additional crafts
February/March - adding farming and the fishing system, and we'll also add Russian and Ukrainian translations to the game.
March/April - experience system, character leveling
April/May - economics, trade, and interaction with NPC
May - mobile version release.


We will try very hard to add a lot of content to the game, so that everyone will be interested in playing our game. It will always be free, so at any time everyone will be able to enjoy this wonderful game! Thank you very much for your support. You are cuties!

notes.title: Give me this one, no, all of them!
notes.content:
We've waited. We've finally waited. January 15, 2025 will be a key milestone for both players and developers of the Piworld world. We still have hundreds of mechanics and goodies to add, change the vibe of the game and completely rebuild the thinking of each survivor, and all for the sake of feeling what I personally wanted to convey to you, dear players. ːsteamhappyː
Please keep in mind that this is our FIRST game, but we will work tirelessly to achieve the perfect game. Although there is no ideal, there will be bugs and other elements in the game, but we will fix them. Please send feedback about bugs and other things to our social networks so that we can track and fix problems as quickly and efficiently as possible. We are waiting for the game. We are really looking forward to it. Let there be light for the world Piworld, let there be frogs!ːsteammockingː
[strike]Oh, how good that my team doesn't know...[/strike]
